About the Project

Oxford's industry studentships sit within the Autonomous Intelligent Machines and Systems CDT. They support doctoral research linked to AI and intelligent systems, with the scientific project and industry relationship defined by the individual studentship.

Research Areas

  • Artificial intelligence
  • Robotics
  • Autonomous systems
